name: Marigold Morning
story: Like the first sun finding your favourite corner. Marigold and warm amber meet a whisper of cardamom.
line: A softer start to your day.

name: First Rain
story: That first-rain feeling, bottled into a little ritual. Jasmine, earthy petrichor and white musk invite you to slow down.

name: Cardamom Smoke
story: Black cardamom, grounding vetiver and a trace of smoked wood. A mood for the moment the day becomes your own.

name: Old Delhi Rose
story: Rose with a little more depth. Saffron and sandalwood bring a warm, quietly nostalgic twist to a familiar favourite.
line: A familiar flower. A new feeling.

name: Nagpur Orange
story: Sweet orange, a little clove and a honeyed finish. A bright companion for open windows and unhurried afternoons.
line: A little sunshine for your space.

name: Mysore Dusk
story: Sandalwood and patchouli settle into soft fig. A grounded, mellow mood for the quieter end of the day.

name: Ganga
desc: An easy, textured accent for a shelf, bedside or quiet corner.

name: Terracotta Kiln
desc: An earthy finish that pairs naturally with warm, woody scent notes.

name: Monsoon
desc: A darker tone for intimate evenings and understated spaces.
